name: Model Counting Competition
description: Modern society is full of computational challenges that rely on probabilistic reasoning, statistics, and combinatorics. Interestingly, many of these questions can be formulated by encoding them into propositional formulas and then asking for its number of models. With a growing interest in practical problem-solving for tasks that involve model counting, the community established the Model Counting (MC) Competition in fall of 2019 with its first iteration in 2020.
